Alger, le 6 août 2026 – Algérie Télécom: Algiers, August 6, 2026 – Algérie Télécom (AT) is strengthening its customer retention strategy with an unprecedented promotional campaign via its Idoom electronic payment service. The historical operator now offers Internet bonuses and subscription extensions for users recharging their plans through digital channels, a direct response to increased competition in the Algerian telecom sector.

Le marché algérien des télécoms, dominé: The Algerian telecom market, dominated by Mobilis (Algérie Télécom), Djezzy (Orascom) and Ooredoo, is marked by a price war and aggressive promotional offers. In 2025, Djezzy launched unlimited 4G plans at 1,000 DZD/month, while Ooredoo introduced data bonuses for top-ups via its Ooredoo Money app. Mobilis, on its side, has enhanced its Mobilis 4G+ offers with extended data volumes.
Dans ce paysage, Algérie Télécom mise su: In this landscape, Algérie Télécom is relying on the digital ecosystem (Idoom, Baridimob) to differentiate itself and retain its customer base, particularly in a context where electronic payment services (such as Wimpay or CIB) are gaining popularity.
